title: ME60102: Fluid Drives And Control
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Fluid Power: its nature, advantages and disadvantages, Hydrostatic transmission
systems, Characteristics of positive displacement pumps, motors and actuators.
Control: Step control, Ramp control of pumps. Valves: directional control,
pressure control, flow control, electro-hydraulic servo valves, proportional
valves. Hydraulic accumulators,Accumulators and Intensifiers (pressure
boosters) in hydraulic control systems. Representation of industrial hydraulic
circuits in symbolic form.Design considerations of hydraulic power transmission
systems. Systems and their dynamic performances. Properties and selection of
hydraulic fluids. Filtration, Pneumatic drives, Fluidics, Fluidic elements and
their industrial applications. Fault diagnosis.
